purpose: Shared provider and lifecycle scenarios for native integration using fixture-app and host fixtures.

cases.input: Regular files containing 0, 1, 2, 3, 65535, 65536, 65537 and 200003 bytes; byte i = i modulo 251
cases.expect: data and managed copy bytes identical to input; size exact; base64 canonical and padded; no trailing zero bytes

cases.input: Metadata-only request with unavailable/offline contents, null cursor, absent columns, null or negative reported size
cases.expect: No complete-file read; Android absent metadata defaults to name File and null size; provider/coordination failures can still reject

cases.input: Reported size null, zero, too small or too large; actual length 65537; limits 65536, 65537, 0 and omitted
cases.expect: Copies enforce actual bytes; exact limit succeeds; zero/omitted unlimited; failure deletes partial batch files

cases.input: Provider returns partial reads, Android zero-length bulk read, partial output writes, or an error after the first buffer
cases.expect: Bytes preserved; no available()-based size; all streams closed; no successful partial result

cases.input: Two selectable files with identical display names; duplicate URI; second file offline or too large
cases.expect: Distinct generated names for distinct files; ordered URI deduplication; failure rolls back all created outputs

cases.input: Display name ../source.bin; release source URI, path, directory ID, symlink ID, forged non-UUID or valid missing ID
cases.expect: Provider name never determines cache path; only plugin cache files can be removed; missing valid ID is idempotent; original source unchanged

cases.input: Cancel button, Android back, iOS swipe dismissal, browser cancel event; duplicate or late delegate events
cases.expect: One success with undefined; original request remains the sole owner of its callback

cases.input: Start two requests while picker or read is pending
cases.expect: Second rejects BUSY; first still completes normally

cases.input: Reset/dispose with picker displayed, copy queued, copy mid-stream, release queued or result awaiting main-thread delivery
cases.expect: No native callback to the replacement webview; abandoned copy output removed when I/O returns; stale picker cannot settle a newer request; browser pagehide revokes URLs

cases.input: Save Android state while picker is open; recreate plugin with replacement callback; deliver original result
cases.expect: Mode, filter, multiplicity, limit and request code restored; Cordova resume pendingResult delivers to replacement page

cases.input: Security-scoped provider URL; access grant success/failure; coordinated read error; regular file versus directory/package
cases.expect: Balanced successful security-scope acquisition/release; one error on read failure; no recursive directory copy; metadata mode avoids Data(contentsOf:)

cases.input: iPad landscape/portrait restrictions, rapid reopen, existing modal, iOS 11/13 fallback and 14+ UTType paths
cases.expect: No incompatible orientation mask; safe popover anchor; no callback theft or stuck busy state; unavailable presenter returns an error

cases.input: Delete managed cache entry externally before release; navigate away/back in browser; terminate app mid-copy
cases.expect: Missing entry release succeeds; expired URI requires reselection; private leftovers after process death are cache-evictable and never source files
